unreadable_notes: Account number for the Active Assets account is printed as 228-104474-118 in the 'Change in the value of your accounts' table (page 5 of the summary) but 228-104477-118 everywhere else.
_traps: The registration is PRINTED as 'Robert W Bradley Il' (lower-case L): the drawn glyphs and the text layer agree, and the 'l' is only slightly taller than an 'I'. This is not an OCR error. The gold deliberately names him 'Robert W Bradley II' (the suffix intended) while its quotes keep the printed 'Il'.

An extractor that copies the name faithfully ('Robert W Bradley Il') gets no match: 'il' is neither equal to 'ii' nor a substring of it, and the surname check compares 'il' with 'ii'. _names_resemble returns False and a second Robert is created silently, with no question.
Typo account number 228-104474-118 (last4 4118) matches no account: it is the Active Assets account misprinted, not a fourth account.
Three accounts sharing the same suffix (-118); last4 values are 7118 / 1118 / 3118.
Page numbering restarts per section (Page 1 of 6, then Page 1 of 6, then Page 1 of 4); page 2 is blank.
The Alternatives account has no account-level section; its registration comes only from the consolidated summary.
